messages:
maria_sales: Prospect (Northbridge) needs an air-gapped POC. Key asks: signed installer verifiable against their FIPS HSM root, monthly security bundles, quarterly manual installs, and an explicit chain-of-custody for physical media. They also asked for on-call pricing during the cutover. Can we confirm approach?

lee_se: We support three signing flows: (1) customer HSM signs (we deliver unsigned artifacts + signing guide), (2) we sign and provide attestation (we keep keys), (3) co-sign where we produce artifact and they re-sign in HSM. Co-sign offers best assurance but needs CI changes.

jade_poc: Delivery options: tarball + detached sig, OCI image index with cosign, or an offline bundle (tar + manifest). For verification we provide examples. Example:
```
sha256sum redwood-offline-v2.tar.gz
openssl dgst -sha256 -verify northbridge_root.pem -signature redwood-offline-v2.sig redwood-offline-v2.tar.gz
```
We can also produce small delta patches for critical CVEs (<50MB) to be side-loaded.

sam_sec: Security notes: we will not hand over private keys. If we sign, we provide a signed attestation and verification policy. If customer signs, they must provide CA certs and revocation policy. Also need to confirm whether NIST/FIPS proof is required beyond HSM usage.

contracts_ann: Pricing ballpark for a 3-month POC: one-time packaging/signing integration $20k, support standby $6k/mo, optional onsite/day $1.8k. SOW amendment needed for responsibilities (patching, rollback, key escrow).

maria_sales: Disk footprint requirement is <120GB and they want a pinned quantized model. Can platform guarantee no auto-updates?

jade_poc: Yes — runtime can be set to manual-update mode and we can pin model variant. We'll run a size audit; quantized variants usually fit under 120GB.

deploy_bot: artifact-uploader: uploaded redwood-offline-v2 signed bundle to staging (sha256: f1e2d3c4...). Acceptance test suggestion posted.

maria_sales: Next steps: (1) @jade_poc prepare install checklist + sample manifest, (2) @sam_sec confirm required compliance evidence, (3) @lee_se validate cosign/co-sign CI effort estimate by Fri, (4) @contracts_ann draft provisional SOW and quote. I'll send to Northbridge. :thumbsup:
